packages.name: env_flag
packages.description: Canonical env-flag truthy/falsy vocabulary shared across the fold monorepo. Zero deps so schema_service and fold_db can both use one parser without cycles.

packages.name: laststore
packages.description: Last Store — multi-collection local document store (segment files, group-commit, real compact)

packages.name: observability
packages.description: Shared telemetry substrate for fold_db (tracing layers, W3C propagation, redaction).

packages.name: folddb_profile
packages.description: Shared `$FOLDDB_HOME` profile loader + endpoint registry + path helpers. A leaf crate (minimal deps) so any LastDB node/tool can resolve the active env profile without heavier dependencies.

packages.name: schema_types
packages.description: Pure wire/domain schema types for schema_service — no fold_db, storage, or HTTP. Diet cut #3 Lambda decouple.

packages.name: app_identity_crypto
packages.description: Shared Ed25519 + JCS (RFC 8785) + signed-envelope helpers for app_identity (Lane A foundation; consumed by schema_service, fold_db_node including dev-mode, exemem-infra).

packages.name: schema_core_resolver
packages.description: Pure schema match engine (native_component_cover) — config-in, no HTTP/identity/storage.

packages.name: schema_service_core
packages.description: Schema service registry brain — schema dedup, canonical fields, views, transforms. Embedder injected by callers (no fastembed/ONNX dep).

packages.name: schema_service_server_shared
packages.description: Shared HTTP handlers for the schema service — mounted by the actix dev binary and the schema-infra Lambda.

packages.name: schema_service_server_http
packages.description: Actix HTTP wrapper around schema_service_server_shared. Dev binary for the canonical schema service.

packages.name: schema_service_client
packages.description: Typed HTTP client for the schema service /v1/* API.

packages.name: schema_service_server_lambda
packages.description: AWS Lambda wrapper around schema_service_server_shared. Deployed to schema.folddb.com via schema-infra.

packages.name: schema_service_s3
packages.description: Shared S3 + DynamoDB persistence backend for schema_service. Implements `ExternalSchemaPersistence` against the canonical S3 layout (schemas.json / canonical_fields.json / near_misses.json / apps.json) and a DynamoDB embeddings table. Consumed by both the request-path Lambda (server_lambda) and the async compile worker (worker).

packages.name: schema_service_worker
packages.description: Operator CLIs for schema_service. Historically hosted the async transform compile worker; that Lambda was retired when transform submission went binary-only (2026-06-21) — there is no untrusted-source compile to offload. The crate now hosts one-shot operator tools (the `purpose_statement` backfill).

packages.name: schema_resolver_pack_publisher
packages.description: Local operator CLI for signing and publishing Schema Resolver Packs.

packages.name: generate_schema_org_classifications
packages.description: One-shot script: cluster-classify every Schema.org property and emit crates/core/data/schema_org/classification_overlay.json. Run manually; the generated overlay is committed to the repo and consumed at service cold start.

packages.name: generate_validated_schema_org_seeds
packages.description: One-shot script: ingest every Schema.org class serially through the full schema service pipeline (real fastembed embedder, real canonical-field semantic matching, real classification overlay) and save the resulting validated schemas + canonical fields as committed JSON snapshots. The runtime loads those JSONs at cold start instead of re-running the pipeline.

packages.name: lastdb_uds
packages.description: Unix-domain-socket transport for the LastDB Mini daemon: socket bind/perms/peer-cred gate (`uds`), HTTP/1.1 framing (`uds_http`), and control-socket route classification (`uds_router`).

packages.name: lastdb_identity
packages.description: The ONE node-identity root shared by every LastDB node binary: the plaintext `identity.key` Ed25519 seed file under the node home (the keyfile-root decision), plus the seed→pubkey→user_hash derivation. A leaf crate (fold_db only) so `fold_db_node` and the minimal `lastdb_node` daemon resolve the SAME identity from the SAME node home without depending on each other.

packages.name: lastdb_host
packages.description: Framework-agnostic LastDB owner-socket host primitives: the wire-shape contract (request parsing, pagination math, response envelope, I4 content-free error mapping, internal-index catalog) shared by BOTH the minimal `lastdbd` daemon (lastdb_node) and the full desktop node (fold_db_node), so the two socket route executors cannot drift.

packages.name: lastdb_node
packages.description: LastDB Mini semantic daemon (`lastdbd`) — the core database host (schema declare/query/mutate + app-identity + cloud sync) served over the owner Unix socket, with NO dependency on fold_db_node: no ingestion, no discovery, no desktop UI. This is the binary the Homebrew `edgevector/lastdb/lastdb` formula ships.

packages.name: lastdb_docstore
packages.description: Reusable LastDB document store: segment files, WAL, codecs, and CAS blobs.
